GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2015-03-04T19:18:45Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: How to create a new service attribute
Description: I would like to create a new attribute that I can add to my service methods, similar to how you have AbpAuthorize.

When I add my attribute to my service methods, I need to ensure that users have a WorkspaceId in their claims.

I have modeled my RequireWorkspaceIdAttribute based on your AbpAuthorizeAttribute and created the following files:
- IRequireWorkspaceIdAttribute
- RequireWorkspaceIdAttribute
- RequireWorkspaceIdAttributeHelper
- RequireWorkspaceIdInterceptor

I have also created a registrar with the following:

```
    private static void Kernel_ComponentRegistered(string key, Castle.MicroKernel.IHandler handler)
    {
        if (typeof(IApplicationService).IsAssignableFrom(handler.ComponentModel.Implementation))
        {
            handler.ComponentModel.Interceptors.Add(new InterceptorReference(typeof(RequireWorkspaceIdInterceptor))); 
        }
    }
```

Which I am calling from MyApplicationModule : AbpModule in my Services.

The Kernel_ComponentRegistered is getting called, but my if-statement never evaluates to true, so when I call my service method, the attribute never fires.

I think my problem is with registering the interceptor.

Any advice would be greatly appreciated.
